nodes.name: chart.py
nodes.summary: Builds guitar charts from raw Basic Pitch note events, applying noise cleaning, octave-shift correction, ghost-note removal, and string/fret assignment, then persisting the result via SongStore.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Python 3.10+ union-type hints (tuple[int, int] | None) and defaultdict for per-MIDI grouping passes.

nodes.name: build_chart
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full chart-building pipeline: reads raw notes from the store, runs all cleaning/shift passes, assigns string and fret positions, then writes the final chart JSON.

nodes.name: clean_notes
nodes.summary: Removes junk from a raw Basic Pitch note list by running four sequential filter passes: out-of-range, too-short/too-quiet, octave doubles, and same-pitch merging.

nodes.name: _apply_shifts
nodes.summary: Applies octave-up shifts to notes below the minimum playable MIDI pitch when low_note_mode is 'shift', stamping shift metadata onto each event.

nodes.name: _merge_shifted_duplicates
nodes.summary: Merges same-pitch notes that overlap after octave shifting, using earliest start, latest end, and loudest amplitude, preserving shift metadata for the merged note.

nodes.name: _drop_octave_doubles
nodes.summary: Drops the quieter of two notes when they start within the onset window and are an octave or octave+fifth apart, eliminating harmonic doubling artifacts.

nodes.name: _merge_same_pitch
nodes.summary: Merges contiguous or overlapping notes at the same MIDI pitch into a single note spanning their combined duration at the loudest amplitude.

nodes.name: _assign_string_fret
nodes.summary: Returns the optimal (string, fret) tuple for a MIDI note, preferring positions within 4 frets of the previous placement to minimize hand movement, falling back to globally lowest fret.

nodes.name: ingest.py
nodes.summary: Imports a song file into the project by computing a SHA-256-based song ID, copying the audio file, and writing an initial song.json with all prep stages set to pending.
nodes.languageNotes: Currently a stub that copies files as-is; real implementation would decode any format to 44.1 kHz stereo WAV via imageio-ffmpeg.

nodes.name: ingest
nodes.summary: Imports a song file, derives its song_id from the SHA-256 hash prefix, copies the audio to the song directory, and writes an initial song.json skeleton.

nodes.name: separate.py
nodes.summary: Runs the Demucs htdemucs_6s model on a song's mix.wav to produce six per-stem WAV files and a backing track that sums all stems except the target instrument.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports torch and demucs lazily (inside the function) to keep them out of the UI process, honoring the architecture rule that the UI never imports heavy ML libraries.

nodes.name: separate
nodes.summary: Splits mix.wav into per-stem WAVs using Demucs htdemucs_6s, then sums and clamps all non-target stems to produce the backing/<target>.wav file.

nodes.name: store.py
nodes.summary: Central file-access layer for the lodestone song folder layout, providing atomic JSON read/write, path helpers, and schema version validation through the SongStore class.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses atomic write-then-rename (os.replace) so a crash never leaves a corrupt JSON file; schema version is enforced on every read.

nodes.name: SongStore
nodes.summary: Provides all read/write operations for the songs directory tree, including path resolution helpers and atomic JSON persistence with schema version checking.

nodes.name: transcribe.py
nodes.summary: Runs Basic Pitch polyphonic pitch detection on a stem WAV file and writes the resulting note events (start_s, end_s, midi, amplitude) as notes/<target>.json via SongStore.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports basic_pitch lazily inside the function to keep the heavy ML dependency out of the UI process, and explicitly casts all numpy types to plain Python types before JSON serialisation.

nodes.name: transcribe
nodes.summary: Runs Basic Pitch on the stem WAV for a target instrument and writes normalised note events (plain Python types, sorted by start_s) to notes/<target>.json.
